role: Adaptive localization, not a held-out validation or parameter-fit result.
input_reference: Levels in dB relative to the existing guitar-peak reference, ref_dbfs=-4.67.
selection_rule: From the engaged/bypass 1 kHz coherent gain, identify partial opening and the largest increase between adjacent levels; retain within-step early/late changes. Select three levels spanning the observed transition for the subsequent silence-versus-loud-history packet. If this range does not bracket reduced and open gain, report that failure and re-center before collecting the long history comparison. Do not label a 4 s plateau a proven equilibrium.
noise_rule: Compare the coherent carrier against neighboring non-harmonic bins and the recorded quiet tail; do not infer creep from magnitude-biased estimates near the measurement floor.
next_experiment: At selected levels, compare at least 6 s at the same constant input after a quiet reset and after a -12 dB conditioning tone; Decay minimum then maximum. Verify reset adequacy against the model slow state and compare early/late recovery and history differences before adding any state.
bypass_warning: All nominal bypass recordings from 2026-10-27-dynamics were actually engaged. They must not be treated as calibration references.
